title: Clear plastic tablecloth
text: Clear plastic tablecloth. This a clear plastic tablecloth.  It came in folded packaging - are their creases? Yes.  Does it have an odor? Yes, it smells like plastic - but it very quickly dissipates.  A warm hair dryer will help smooth some of the creases - but not completely.  I buys these, use them for a period of time and just replace them.  I will admit that I am thinking of getting glass.  It would sure be easier to deal with and clean - less waste.  So far, these have protected my table from serious damage. I have had some that were quick a bit thinner, although this one is not super thick to be fair.  It has a raw edge - meaning it's just a cut piece of plastic.  I have had some that had a thread sewn edge - the thinner ones usually.  I think I like the raw cut rather than the sewn edge.  To me, it stands out less.  The sewn edge draws your eye, in my opinion.  For the price - this works as I need it to. It's not perfect, but works.
